flags.description: Verbose observation surfaces for local ATC
Enable query-aware SuperSqueeze context compression across MCP, CAG, and HAHP
Route CLI factory workflows and BotRegistry calls through HATH0R-MCP (Priority 1)
Enforce strict Task -> Hath0r-CLI/MCP -> Computer -> Web iteration cascade
Enforce ArchitecturePreservationBot, SubstrateUtilizationBot, and TaskCompletionVerifierBot gates
Automatically run CCCD agent calibration (DSPy + Taguchi L9 + L2WS + MLflow/Phoenix) prior to a task when calibration TTL expires
Maximum calibration age in hours before automatic pre-task re-calibration is triggered
Enforce Workflow-First Standard: require every task to execute via a declarative workflow or offer to create one first
Enforce Canonical Feature Definition: every feature is a service run by >=1 Bot with Level 1 (HATH0R-MCP) and Level 2 (HATH0R-CLI / Bot Memory) utilizing AgentGraph
